item.text: {"summary":"Draft is publishable after one small methodological clarification; resolver, unit, first-print rule, resolution date, and point/interval coherence are otherwise sound.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"prior_update_interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The compact step says the historical sample contains 53 weekly changes from June 28, 2025 through June 27, 2026, but that date range appears to contain 53 weekly observations and 52 week-to-week changes unless an additional prior observation was included.","actionRequested":"Clarify whether the interval sigma used 53 observations/52 changes or included one earlier week to produce 53 changes, and adjust the sample-count wording or sigma if needed."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State that FRED is used only as a history mirror, not as the resolution source, to avoid any ambiguity.","Mention the July 16 intermediate release as future evidence not used in this forecast, or omit it from the source summary to keep the resolver focus on July 23."]}
